A Day in Infantino's Office: Baby Messi and FIFA's Destiny ​Welcome to Gianni Infantino's office. Today is 'Bring Your Child to Work Day,' but this isn't about scanning documents. Infantino is giving his 'son'—baby Messi—the keys to FIFA. This is more than a badge; it's the start of the 'Boss's Son' policy. ​Infantino asks Messi to draw the actual winner of the 2026 World Cup. Messi's drawing of Argentina lifting the cup? Approved and signed by Infantino. "It will happen," says Infantino. It's that simple. ​But the core rule was on the board: "IF LEO CRIES = PENALTY!" Infantino orders the referees to officiate exactly how Messi wants. He even ensures a penalty is given to Messi by drawing a line in the VAR room. ​Ronaldo and Mbappé's reactions in the daycare show their frustration with the new 'Boss's Son' reality of football.
